en: The postcard features an old photograph (hand-colored) of a city square with several people standing on walkways, benches, and surrounding street buildings showing late 19th or early 20th-century European architecture. Visible are some trees, streetlights, and telegraph poles. Text on the front reads 'Sundsvall,' and handwritten notes cover parts of both sides. The reverse has printed guidelines and handwritten Swedish text, as well as the heading 'BREVKORT (Carte postale),' indicating it is a postcard for international and domestic use.
